study: P7.4 new LE-PINN study: Ma-form RANS residual + current-loss weights, data efficiency (NOT P4.3 attempt 4; nothing is promoted to the production cycle)
registered_before: any training or scoring of this study. Known: P4.3 attempts 1-3 and their diagnoses, the P6.5 audit. Compute-only benchmark (timing, no scores) before the budget below was fixed (see compute.benchmark).

data_access.question: sent to the user by the interactive session before this dispatch (viscosity access)
data_access.answer_recorded: no answer is present in the repository, the plan or this executor's input (headless dispatch, started 2026-09-27 11:16, cannot receive messages); the plan's stated recommended assumption is therefore applied
data_access.assumption: every WIND field label, including viscosity (mu_l, mu_t), is available ONLY at the sampled training rows, identically for both arms. The physics arm gets no held-out viscosity or derivative. mu_t is a network output trained on WIND mu_t at the training rows only (a training-only learned viscosity; information budget = the run's rows, the same as the data-only arm, which learns the same six outputs). Molecular viscosity is Sutherland's law of the predicted T (a closure, not a label). Geometry (grid coordinates, wall shape and normals), the WIND file's freestream reference constants and the physical wall conditions are not held-out flow measurements.

data.source: WIND S-A RANS solution of the Sajben weak-shock case (sajben.cgd/.cfl, NPARC archive): one flow case; fields rho, u, v, p, T, mu_l, mu_t; no measured Reynolds stresses, no k
data.rows: every grid node except the inflow column i = 0: 80 x 51 = 4080
data.heldout_test: fixed 20 % of the 4080 rows (816 rows), numpy default_rng(7401).permutation; never used in training, scalers, selection or stopping
data.denominator_100pct: the 3264-row training POOL = all 4080 rows minus the held-out test rows. Fractions 2, 5, 10, 25, 100 % of this pool: f002=65, f005=163, f010=326, f025=816, f100=3264 rows
data.experiment: data/raw/data.Mach46.txt wall pressures: external scoring only; never used to select, checkpoint or stop
data.labels_used: rho, u, v, p, T, mu_t at the run's training rows (mu_l is not used)

arms.physics: L = lambda_data L_data + lambda_phys L_phys + lambda_bc L_bc with the detached current-loss weights (le_pinn_ma.ma_weights)

design.pairing: for each (seed, fraction) the physics and data-only runs share the training rows, scalers, initial weights (torch.manual_seed(seed) immediately before model construction), architecture, optimizer, schedule and epoch budget; the only difference is the loss

physics.equations: le_pinn_ma module docstring (planar steady compressible RANS, conservative fluxes, variable mu_eff = Sutherland(T) + mu_t, Boussinesq stress combined with the molecular stress in ONE flux, heat flux cp (mu/Pr + mu_t/Pr_t) grad T, EOS p = rho R T)
physics.gamma_R: from the WIND reference record (gamma 1.4, R 286.96)
physics.not_modelled: isotropic 2/3 rho k (S-A gives no k; k is not in H either): an approximation, not an exact Ma replication
physics.derivatives: autograd w.r.t. physical coordinates (exact chain rule through the input normalisation and output de-standardisation)
physics.scaling: residuals / (rho_r a_r / L), (rho_r a_r^2 / L), (rho_r a_r^3 / L), (rho_r a_r^2 for EOS); rho_r, a_r, T_r = WIND reference; L = throat height
physics.L_phys: sum over {continuity, x_mom, y_mom, energy, eos} of the mean squared scaled residual over the collocation points
physics.L_bc: mean (u/a_r)^2 + mean (v/a_r)^2 + mean ((L/T_r) dT/dn)^2 over both walls' nodes (i >= 1); n = unit normal of the actual wall from its coordinates (upper wall curved)
physics.L_data: mean squared error of the six standardised outputs over the training rows
physics.weights: Ma et al. (2026) Eqs. 30-33 (p. 5) in the forms fixed by the Phase 7 plan: lambda_data = .1 + .9 sigmoid((Lphys + Lbc - Ldata)/(Ldata + eps)); lambda_phys = .1 + .9 sigmoid((Ldata - Lphys)/(Lphys + eps)); lambda_bc = .1 + .9 sigmoid((Ldata - Lbc)/(Lbc + eps)); eps = 1e-8; recomputed every epoch from the current losses and DETACHED (no gradient through the weights)
physics.collocation: fixed pool per seed: uniform draws in continuous grid-index space (xi in [1, 80], eta in [0, 50]) mapped by bilinear interpolation of the grid coordinates (le_pinn_ma.collocation_points, default_rng(7500 + seed)); follows the grid's wall clustering; geometry only
physics.boundary_points: the 80 lower-wall and 80 upper-wall grid nodes i = 1..80

model.architecture: dual network (global 2->400, 6 hidden x 400 -> 6; boundary 2->100, 6 hidden x 100 -> 2 (p, T) fused within fusion_delta of a wall), tanh, Xavier-uniform weights, zero biases
model.inputs: physical (x, y), normalised inside the model to [-1, 1] by the GEOMETRY bounding box (x_min..x_max, 0..y_max of the grid coordinates; no flow data)
model.outputs: standardised [rho, u, v, p, T, log1p(mu_t / mu_ref)]; mean/std from the run's TRAINING rows only (shared by the paired arms, which use the same rows); mu_t = mu_ref expm1(.) clamped >= 0

training.lr_schedule: CosineAnnealingLR(T_max = epochs, eta_min = lr * eta_min_factor), stepped per epoch
training.batching: full batch over the run's training rows every epoch
training.checkpoint_selection: final epoch; no validation set, no early stopping, no held-out or experimental data
training.restart_policy: infrastructure restarts resume from the last atomic checkpoint (model, optimizer, scheduler, RNG states) with an identical configuration hash; a changed configuration is refused; a non-finite loss or any other error ends the run as FAILED with no retry

scoring.script: scripts/validation/report_sajben_ma.py (runs only when all 30 runs are complete)
scoring.experimental: upper and lower wall P/P_in shape-L2 against data.Mach46.txt with the existing scorer (scripts/validation/sajben_validation.py: build_sajben_grid 60 x 25 from sajben.x.fmt, compute_wall_cp_errors with the throat-height mapping), existing bands < 0.10 pass / 0.10-0.25 partial / > 0.25 fail; degenerate (flat) predictions flagged
scoring.primary_scalar: worse of the two walls: max(l2_upper, l2_lower)
scoring.wind_heldout: on the 816 held-out WIND rows: relative L2 ||pred - ref|| / ||ref|| and RMSE for each of rho, u, v, p, T; declared aggregate = mean of the five relative L2; viscosity separately: relative L2 and RMSE of mu_t and of mu_eff = Sutherland(T_pred) + mu_t vs WIND mu_l + mu_t
scoring.labels: WIND held-out = in-case spatial interpolation on the same flow case; experiment = external comparison on the same geometry and condition; no cross-case or cross-geometry claim

claim.per_fraction: three seed scores per arm on the PRIMARY scalar (worse-wall experimental shape-L2)
claim.benefit: mean(data-only primary) - mean(physics primary) > seed spread, at >= 2 of the fractions {2, 5, 10} %
claim.reported_regardless: per-seed paired differences, mean/SD per arm, all five fractions, both the experimental and the WIND held-out evaluations, bands, degenerate flags, final training-side losses, failures
claim.completeness: a terminal claim requires all 30 registered runs COMPLETE (exit 0, record, checkpoint hash); the report refuses otherwise
claim.no_selection: no wall, metric, seed, checkpoint, fraction or run is chosen after outcomes; no held-out score chooses hyperparameters, splits, stopping rules or winning runs
claim.failure: a new-study failure is a result, not permission for another unregistered attempt

compute.note: the supervisor never runs more than max_threads torch threads at once; the v6 calibration/blend queues use 6 process workers of their own

benchmark.kind: compute-only benchmark (timing); smoke runs with temporary outputs under /tmp; no held-out, experimental or training-loss comparison was computed or read
benchmark.when: 2026-09-27 ~11:40, while the v6 calibration job (6 workers) was running
benchmark.host: Apple M3 Pro (5 performance + 6 efficiency cores), CPU float32
benchmark.reading: physics epoch ~3.0 s at 4 threads and ~3.7 s at 2 threads (full 3264-point collocation pool, second derivatives); data-only epoch ~0.2 s. Thread scaling is poor, so 2 threads per run with up to 5 concurrent runs (10 threads) is the most throughput per core. Projected: 15 physics runs x 5000 epochs ~ 5-8 h each, 3 waves -> ~20-26 h wall clock; data-only ~20 min each.
benchmark.decision: KEEP the established budget (5000 full-batch epochs, physics on a 3264-point pool every epoch = the P4.3 attempt-3 physics point count). The benchmark justifies only the thread/concurrency layout, not a budget change.
